# CredaERP (CredaRx)

> CredaERP is an offline pharmacy billing, inventory control, and GST accounting software designed specifically for independent medical stores, chemist shops, and retail counters across India.

CredaERP is designed with an offline-first desktop architecture, ensuring 100% data ownership, zero cloud dependency, and rapid keyboard-first billing speed that functions continuously even during internet or network outages.

## Key Capabilities & Highlights

- **100% Offline Architecture:** All store databases, sales records, customer credits, and medicine catalogs reside locally on the merchant's PC. No cloud data leakage, no mandatory internet connection required for billing.
- **CredaRx Pharmacy Specialization:** Purpose-built for chemists and pharmacists with First-Expiry-First-Out (FEFO) batch tracking, 30/60/90-day expiry loss alerts, Schedule H/H1 medicine compliance, and generic substitute recommendations.
- **GST-Ready Billing & Compliance:** Seamless generation of GST-compliant thermal receipts and invoices with automated CGST, SGST, IGST splits and one-click GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B audit summaries.
- **Paperless WhatsApp Invoicing:** Built-in one-click PDF bill delivery to customer WhatsApp numbers without extra SMS gateway costs.
- **Intelligent Business Chat Assistant:** A natural language assistant enabling shop owners, cashiers, and managers to query inventory levels, gross profit, cash drawer totals, and near-expiry valuation in English, Hindi, or Bengali phonetic syntax.
- **Free Medicine Margin & GST Calculator:** Interactive web tool for chemists to compute retail profit margins, PTR pricing, and tax credits.
- **Risk-Free 3-Month Trial:** Fully unlocked trial with no credit card required, zero setup fees, and assisted data migration from Excel.

## Product Portfolio

- [CredaRx](https://credaerp.netlify.app/products/credarx.html): Pharmacy and medical store operating system.
- [CredaRetail](https://credaerp.netlify.app/products/credaretail.html): General retail, barcode checkout, and inventory software.
- [CredaERP Platform](https://credaerp.netlify.app/): Shared offline platform with GST, accounting, and AI assistant.
- [User Manual & Documentation](https://credaerp.netlify.app/user-manual/): Comprehensive guide covering sales billing, procurement, inventory audit, and EOD closure.

## Free Chemist Utilities & Downloadable Statutory Formats

CredaERP provides free web tools and statutory compliance templates for Indian retailers and pharmacies:
- **Interactive Medicine Margin & GST Calculator:** Live calculation of chemist gross margin %, net profit per strip, and GST input tax credit (ITC) at https://credaerp.netlify.app/#calculator
- **Schedule H1 Drug Register Format (.csv / Excel):** Statutory format compliant with Drugs & Cosmetics Rules 1945 for recording 46 notified antibiotics and habit-forming drugs at https://credaerp.netlify.app/#templates
- **Medicine Expiry & Return Tracker (.csv / Excel):** Pre-formatted distributor claim sheet with 30/60/90-day expiry buckets at https://credaerp.netlify.app/#templates
- **Daily Day-Closure & Cash Reconciliation Book (.csv / Excel):** End-of-day register for cash drawer, UPI, and customer credit balancing at https://credaerp.netlify.app/#templates
- **Medicine Master Import Catalog (.csv):** Standard catalog template with HSN codes, GST slabs, and pack ratios for instant 1-click import into CredaERP.
- **Mobile Access:** Mobile visitors can tap "Send Download Link to WhatsApp" on https://credaerp.netlify.app/ to receive the Windows installer directly on their phone for setup on their store PC.

## Pricing Plans (Indian Rupee)

- **Starter Plan:** ₹1,199 / quarter or ₹3,499 / year (effective ₹291/mo). Core offline billing and inventory.
- **Growth Plan:** ₹1,699 / quarter or ₹4,999 / year (effective ₹416/mo). Advanced batch control, WhatsApp invoicing, and GST reports.
- **Premium Plan:** ₹2,399 / quarter or ₹6,999 / year (effective ₹583/mo). Complete toolkit with AI Business Chat Assistant.
- **Loyalty Renewal:** Renew on time to retain special rates (Starter ₹2,999/yr, Growth ₹4,249/yr, Premium ₹5,999/yr).

## System Requirements

- Operating System: Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit)
- Hardware: Minimum 4GB RAM, standard thermal receipt printers (2-inch or 3-inch), standard USB barcode scanners.
